input_text:
CONTRACT CONTEXT:
9. Confidential Information shall not be reproduced in any form except as required to accomplish the intent of this Agreement.  

TARGET STATEMENT:
The contract entails that the relevant party must keep confidential the existence, terms, subject matter, or status of the agreement, negotiations, discussions, or transaction between the parties.

DECISION TASK:
Determine whether the contract context entails the target statement.

arguments.text: The contract context restricts only the 'reproduction' of 'Confidential Information,' which does not equate to a general obligation to keep the agreement's existence, terms, or status confidential.
arguments.legal_rule: Contract NLI entailment requires matching material elements and scope; a restriction on reproduction does not entail a broad confidentiality obligation over the agreement itself.
arguments.evidence_span: Confidential Information shall not be reproduced in any form except as required to accomplish the intent of this Agreement.

arguments.text: The narrative provides no definition or explicit scope indicating that 'Confidential Information' encompasses the agreement itself, its negotiations, or its status.
arguments.legal_rule: In contract interpretation, undefined terms are not presumed to cover specific external subjects like the agreement's terms or status without explicit textual support.
arguments.evidence_span: Confidential Information shall not be reproduced in any form except as required to accomplish the intent of this Agreement.

arguments.text: The target statement requires confidentiality of the agreement's terms and subject matter, but the contract context lacks any provision addressing the confidentiality of the agreement or its negotiations.
arguments.legal_rule: Entailment in contract NLI fails when the target introduces material elements (e.g., confidentiality of the agreement itself) absent from the source text.
arguments.evidence_span: Confidential Information shall not be reproduced in any form except as required to accomplish the intent of this Agreement.
